CustomField.label: Market test account id
CustomField.description: The customer account an RFP project is attached to when none was chosen: the org's Market Test account. RFP_Project__c.Customer__c is a master-detail, so a project without a customer cannot exist; this is the account that stands in for "no customer", and sharing it is what lets the whole pricing team work the same market tests. Held as an id rather than a name so renaming the account breaks nothing.
